parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.id,
  b.name,
  b.email,
  COALESCE(w.used_count, 0) AS whatsapp_used,
  COALESCE(c.used_count, 0) AS content_used,
  COALESCE(v.used_count, 0) AS voice_used,
  COALESCE(a.used_count, 0) AS audit_used,
  b.subscription_tier
FROM businesses b
LEFT JOIN whatsapp_usage w ON b.id = w.business_id AND w.month = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM')
LEFT JOIN content_usage c ON b.id = c.business_id AND c.month = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM')
LEFT JOIN voice_usage v ON b.id = v.business_id AND v.month = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM')
LEFT JOIN audit_usage a ON b.id = a.business_id AND a.month = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM')
WHERE b.active = true
